Nora: Hi team  checked my bag in LAX and it was delayed to my destination (client trip). I had to buy toiletries and one change of clothes ( total $58) to get through the first day. Can I expense these "essentials"?
Aisha (People Ops): Sorry that happened. Yes, we reimburse reasonable essentials purchased because of delayed or lost baggage. Please upload: the itemized receipts, the airline property irregularity report (PIR) or delayed baggage reference number, and a brief note in the expense saying which items were for business readiness.
Nora: I filed a PIR at the airport and have the reference number (TCK12345). Receipts: drugstore_receipt.pdf (toothbrush, socks, charger) and clothes_receipt.jpg.
Aisha (People Ops): Perfect. A couple of policy points:
  - Reimbursable items: basic toiletries, undergarments, one change of clothes, phone charger, and transport to get essentials. Not reimbursable: luxury items, electronics > $100 without approval.
  - Limits: we usually cap essentials reimbursement to $100 per incident unless manager approves more. If airline reimburses you directly, please note that and attach airline correspondence; we won't double-reimburse.
  - Currency: upload card statement or let Expensify use the default FX conversion.
Nora: The total is $58 USD, so under the cap. I already filed the PIR and the airline emailed confirmation of delayed bag delivery for tomorrow.
Ben (Manager): I approve Nora's essentials purchase for business readiness. Approving in expense comments.
Aisha (People Ops): Great  once you submit mark category = "Incidentals -> Baggage delay essentials" and include PIR ref and airline email. Finance/Claims will reconcile with any airline payout.
Claims-Bot: Reminder: Claims workflow at https://intranet.redwood.com/travel-claims. If airline reimburses later, please update the expense and tag @Ben so we can adjust.
Nora: Uploaded receipts + PIR screenshot + airline email. Submitting now. Thanks folks.
Aisha (People Ops): Received  we'll fast-track as a baggage incident. If finance needs anything else we'll ping. Closing thread when processed. :white_check_mark:
